priorities.summary: Path traversal and NULL-byte flaws in Fortinet FortiMail let an unauthenticated remote attacker write arbitrary files to the appliance via crafted HTTP/HTTPS requests. Fortinet confirmed active zero-day exploitation; added to the CISA KEV catalog on October 1 — patch immediately.

Authentication bypass in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (vManage) via improper URI-encoding handling lets an unauthenticated attacker reach the management API with administrator privileges — no workaround exists. Cisco confirmed active exploitation in September; CISA added it to KEV on September 30 with an October 3 federal remediation deadline.

Heap-based buffer overflow in F5 BIG-IP Access Policy Manager gives unauthenticated remote code execution when APM is configured as an OAuth Authorization Server (17.1.0–17.1.3, 17.5.0–17.5.1, 21.1.0). Actively exploited zero-day; on the CISA KEV catalog since September 22 — restricting the management interface does not mitigate it.

model.name: Google Gemini 4 Argon
model.summary: Google's new top-tier frontier model anchoring the Gemini 4 generation, larger than its previous Pro line and posting leading marks on DeepSWE, Vals Index, AutomationBench and LVBench. Biggest technical jump is 1M-token output (up from 64k); initial access is limited to vetted cyber defenders via the Fairwind program and the US government before wider release.
